verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iPhone and iPad, so reviewing pull requests on the go is a fair question for it. The evidence covers languages, Vim, packages, Shortcuts and file access, but never mentions git, pull requests or any code-review workflow. Vim editing and pickFolder file access are adjacent features, not PR review.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review pull requests from my phone while on the go
